title: Frontier AI and the Future of Intelligence

key_discoveries.title: Gemini Embeddings 2 — Omnimodal Unified Semantic Space
key_discoveries.description: Single vector represents 8K tokens text, 128s video, 80s audio, or full PDF in one shared semantic space. Inspired by neuroscience 'Jennifer Aniston cells' (concept neurons that fire regardless of input modality). Eliminates cross-modal mapping loss; SoTA retrieval across modalities from one index. Hadsell framed retrieval as co-equal with generation at the frontier: 'sometimes generate, sometimes retrieve.'

key_discoveries.title: Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL) for Elastic Embeddings
key_discoveries.description: Same network produces nested embeddings at multiple dimensionalities (starting 256 dims, expanding). Smaller embeddings are prefixes of larger ones, so applications can trade accuracy for latency/cost at inference time without retraining. General pattern applicable to any future embedding pipeline.

key_discoveries.title: GraphCast — Spherical GNN Weather Model
key_discoveries.description: Graph neural network over a spherical mesh predicting full atmospheric state up to 15 days out across 100 variables. Hurricane Lee (2024) landfall called accurately 9 days out vs 6 days for physics-based models.

key_discoveries.title: GenCast — Probabilistic Weather Successor
key_discoveries.description: Probabilistic version of GraphCast acknowledging weather is chaotic. 97% more accurate than 1300 gold-standard benchmarks. 15-day forecast in 8 minutes on a single chip vs. hours on a traditional supercomputer.

key_discoveries.title: FGN — Functional Generative Network for Direct Cyclone Prediction
key_discoveries.description: Rather than forecasting a generic weather field and post-processing for cyclone information, FGN directly predicts cyclones with trajectory, wind speed, category, and eye formation as first-class outputs. Used operationally by the US National Hurricane Center.

key_discoveries.title: Genie 3 — Real-Time Photorealistic World Models with Memory
key_discoveries.description: Text prompt generates interactive real-time photorealistic 3D worlds with two qualitative breakthroughs: persistent memory (walk away from an object, come back, it's still there) and live re-prompting (inject new prompt mid-experience to transform the world coherently). Available to Gemini Ultra subscribers. Applications: new form of gaming via adversarial prompting, immersive education.

key_discoveries.title: 'Root nodes, not leaves' research philosophy
key_discoveries.description: Hadsell's guiding research-prioritization heuristic: resist the flashiest leaf problems, hunt upstream for deepest problems whose solutions unlock many downstream capabilities. Applicable as a tag/framing for our own research catalogue curation.

deep_dive_candidates.reason: Gemini Embeddings 2 product page — API access, pricing, MRL dimensionality options; candidate future retrieval backend for catalogue search and devlog recall
Matryoshka Representation Learning paper (Kusupati et al.) — technical foundation for elastic embeddings; reference for any future embedding pipeline we build
GraphCast announcement and paper — foundational example of replacing physics simulation with GNN prediction; general 'learn the manifold instead of simulating it' pattern
GenCast probabilistic weather model — demonstrates the accuracy-per-compute win of neural forecasters over supercomputer ensembles
Genie 3 announcement — long-shot substrate for agent simulation/training environments with persistent memory and live re-prompting
Original Genie paper — foundation world-models architecture underlying the Genie 1/2/3 progression

relevance_for_orchestrator: Foundational frontier AI research, not agent orchestration. No direct transfer to tmux L-Thread workers, worktree isolation, or PR review loops. Ingested for three tangential reasons: (1) Gemini Embeddings 2 + MRL as a future retrieval backend for catalogue search and devlog recall once API is available; (2) Genie 3 persistent-memory worlds as a long-shot agent simulation substrate to watch; (3) 'root nodes not leaves' framing as a useful curation heuristic for the research librarian.
key_insight: DeepMind's VP of Research frames embeddings + world models as co-equal with LLMs at the frontier; retrieval is not a transitional hack waiting to be replaced by bigger context windows.
